risks.risk: Volume growth or strategic-customer wins can coexist with gross-margin compression if customer pricing concessions are not offset by manufacturing cost reductions at scale.

executionRisks.claim: Commercial scale requires cost-down execution to keep pace with volume discounts or strategic-customer pricing; higher unit volume alone does not establish improving unit economics.

falsifiers.claim: This downside would weaken if later primary evidence shows realized manufacturing cost reductions consistently offset customer pricing concessions while production volume scales, preserving or expanding gross margins.

causalEdges.edge: volume/strategic-customer pricing concessions -> lower realized pricing -> if cost-down lags, gross-margin compression despite volume growth

alphaBoundary: Qualitative source-addressed downside/execution-risk/falsifier evidence only; no Alpha scoreRecord, numeric Methodology component, numeric risk score, valuation, rank, or data-confidence score.
authorityBoundary: Methodology 1.0, Beast/integrity gates, append-only evidence, and Earth Core canonical authority unchanged.
